## 3. Real Time-Interval Clash Rules

Because theory and lab periods operate with different offset intervals:
- **Theory Periods**: 50 minutes class + 5 minutes break on each period (`08:00–08:50`, `08:55–09:45`, `09:50–10:40`, etc.).
- **Lab Periods**: 50 minutes class + consecutive adjacency (`08:00–08:50`, `08:50–09:40`).

### Clash Condition:
Two meetings $M_A$ and $M_B$ clash if and only if:
$$M_A.\text{day} = M_B.\text{day} \quad \text{AND} \quad M_A.\text{start\_min} < M_B.\text{end\_min} \quad \text{AND} \quad M_B.\text{start\_min} < M_A.\text{end\_min}$$
- Touching boundaries (e.g. Lab 1 ending at `08:50` and Lab 2 starting at `08:50`) do **NOT** clash ($530 < 530$ is False).
- Partial overlaps (e.g. Theory Period 1 `08:00–08:50` and Lab `08:50–09:40` share 0 overlap; Theory Period 2 `08:55–09:45` overlaps Lab `08:50–09:40` from `08:55` to `09:40`, exactly 45 minutes of clash).
